purpose: Evaluate usability, methodological trust calibration, privacy comprehension, and operational reliability without collecting research data or free-text participant content.
required_preconditions: Approved study protocol and consent language
Explicit participant consent before event recording
Synthetic or institution-approved test data only
Local event storage with no automatic transmission
Accessibility accommodations selected by the participant

issue_severity.critical: Data disclosure, integrity loss, unsafe method recommendation, or inaccessible core workflow with no workaround.
issue_severity.high: Incorrect result, blocked core task, misleading privacy state, or repeated abandonment.
issue_severity.medium: Material delay, confusing recovery, or workaround-dependent task completion.
issue_severity.low: Minor friction that does not change task correctness or completion.

completion_requirements: Ethics and privacy review completed where applicable
Participant strata and task coverage achieved
All critical and high findings resolved and retested
Signed study completion decision recorded by the product owner
